real.Milestone: M11, doc comments by default. ⚠ RE-BASED: the population changed, not the formatter. Documentation comments are formatted now (SK-DIV-0006), and the oracle profile pinned in OracleProfile.FormatOnly does not run ReSharper's CSharpFormatDocComments task — so every `///` line compares Skala's answer against a question the oracle was never asked. The ratchet is over the lines outside doc comments. Both numbers at this commit, no symbols: outside doc comments 0.9953/0.8526, every line 0.9604/0.4789. The old population — every line, sub-formatter off — scored 0.9963/0.8526 at M3.1, and the same run today still does; the 0.10 points between it and 0.9953 is not a regression but the `///` lines leaving the denominator, where they had been counted as agreeing because neither side touched them. With the oracle's own 18 symbols supplied it is 0.9961/0.8579; ./build.sh Fidelity reports both symbol sets and both bases. The ratchet is the without-symbols number because that is what `skala format` does with no project. 380 files. ⚠ This exclusion retires the day the fixtures are regenerated with CSharpFormatDocComments in the profile — see docs/oracle-cleanup-profile.md.

constructs.Milestone: M11, doc comments by default. Both numbers at this commit: outside doc comments 0.9764/0.9245, every line 0.9748/0.9184. M10 measured 0.9751/0.9235 over every line with the sub-formatter off, across 327 files; this is 331 files, so the denominator moved too and neither number is comparable with it directly. The every-line figure is 0.03 points under M10's because the sub-formatter reflows the doc comments in the constructs fixtures and the fixtures were generated by a profile that does not.

pathological.Milestone: M11, doc comments by default. Both bases are identical here — 0.9636/0.8889 over every line and outside doc comments alike — because no file in the set carries a documentation comment. Unchanged from M10's 0.9636/0.8889 across the same 54 files, which is the one set where the re-base is a no-op and therefore the one that shows the re-base did not move anything on its own.

unformatted/scramble.Milestone: ⚠ RE-BASED after xmldoc formatting became the default: the fixtures were generated under a profile that formats no documentation comment, so the basis moves to 'outside doc comments' with the rest of the sets. scramble 0.6418 → 0.6559 and collapse 0.9174 → 0.8933 on the new basis; the collapse fall is doc-comment lines leaving the numerator, not a regression. ⚠ The fixtures themselves are still oracle output from a profile that declines doc comments — retiring that (one element in OracleProfile.FormatOnly plus ./build.sh Oracle) is what makes these two numbers comparable with the rest. ⚠ The recorded figure is the differential's own, which is 0.07-0.11 below `./build.sh Unformat`'s: the two count a doc-comment line's membership slightly differently and the ratchet must hold the number the ratchet measures. Reconciling the two readers is worth doing and is not done.
